title: Delivery
body:
Where we deliver

We deliver to addresses in the United Kingdom. The delivery options and prices for your address are shown at checkout before you pay.

When your order is sent

Items marked “In stock” are packed and sent after your payment is confirmed. You will receive an email with tracking details as soon as the parcel leaves us.

Items marked “Pre-order” are sent once they arrive with us. The product page shows the expected date where we have one. See Pre-orders.

Large and heavy items

Tall trees and oversized displays may travel in more than one box or by a specialist carrier. If your order needs a booked delivery slot we will contact you to arrange it.

If something arrives damaged

Keep the packaging, take a photo and contact us. We will arrange a replacement or a refund.

Tracking

You can check the status of an order at any time on the Track an order page.

title: Returns and refunds
body:
Changing your mind

You can cancel an order for any reason up to [[RETURN_WINDOW]] after the day you receive your goods. Tell us within that time, then send the items back within 14 days of telling us.

To cancel, contact us with your order number. You can use the model cancellation form below, but you do not have to.

Sending items back

Items should be unused and in their original packaging where possible. You may handle goods as you would in a shop. If an item has been used beyond that, we may reduce the refund to reflect any loss in value.

Unless an item is faulty or not as described, the cost of returning it is yours. Return address:

[[RETURNS_ADDRESS]]

Refunds

We refund the price of the goods and the standard delivery charge you paid, to your original payment method, [[REFUND_TIMING]].

Faulty or damaged items

If an item is faulty, damaged or not as described, you have rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015. These include the right to reject it for a full refund within 30 days of receiving it, and to a repair or replacement after that. Contact us and we will put it right.

Items we cannot take back

The right to cancel does not apply to goods made to your specification or clearly personalised.

Model cancellation form

Ordered on / received on: (dates)

Nothing on this page affects your statutory rights.

title: Pre-orders
body:
How pre-orders work

Some items can be ordered before they arrive in our warehouse. These are marked “Pre-order” on the product page, in your basket and at checkout.

Payment

Payment for a pre-order is taken in full when you place the order.

Delivery dates

Where we have an expected date, it is shown on the product page. Dates are estimates from our suppliers and can move. If a date changes we will email you.

Orders with in-stock and pre-order items

If your order mixes in-stock and pre-order items, we will tell you by email how it will be sent.

Cancelling a pre-order

You can cancel a pre-order for a full refund at any time before it is sent. After delivery, the normal returns policy applies.

title: Warranty
body:
Your legal rights

Everything we sell must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose and as described. If it is not, the Consumer Rights Act 2015 gives you the right to a repair, replacement or refund. Any manufacturer’s warranty is in addition to these rights.

Manufacturer warranties

Where a product comes with a manufacturer’s warranty, its length and what it covers are listed on the product page.

Making a claim

Contact us with your order number, a description of the problem and a photo. We will tell you the next step.

What is not covered

Fair wear and tear, accidental damage, and damage caused by use other than as instructed, for example using an indoor-only item outdoors.

title: Care and assembly
body:
Assembling an artificial tree

Build from the stand up. Slot each section in fully before adding the next, then shape the branches from the inside out, starting with the lowest layer. Each tree comes with its own instructions; follow those where they differ.

Lights

Unwind string lights fully before switching on. Check whether a set is rated for indoor or outdoor use before hanging it outside, and use only the power supply it came with. Switch lights off when you leave the house or go to bed.

Glass ornaments

Dust with a soft dry cloth. Store each piece wrapped, in a divided box, away from damp.

Wreaths and garlands

Reshape the tips after unpacking. If used outdoors, choose a sheltered spot unless the product page says it is weather-resistant.

Storing for next year

Pack items clean and dry. Keep the original boxes for trees and large displays, or use a tree storage bag. Store in a cool, dry place.

Need the instructions again?

Contact us with the product name and we will send them.

title: Privacy policy
body:
This policy explains how [[COMPANY]] (“we”) uses personal data collected through [[DOMAIN]]. We are the data controller. Contact: [[EMAIL]].

Data we collect

  • Orders: name, delivery and billing address, email, phone number if given, items ordered and order history.
  • Payments: handled by our payment provider, Stripe. We do not see or store your full card details.
  • Messages: anything you send through the contact form or by email.
  • Newsletter: your email address and the time you confirmed your subscription.
  • Site use: a basket cookie, your cookie choices and, with your consent, analytics and advertising data.

Why we use it and our lawful basis

  • To fulfil and deliver your order and handle returns (contract).
  • To keep tax and accounting records (legal obligation).
  • To answer enquiries and prevent fraud (legitimate interests).
  • To send marketing emails and to use analytics or advertising cookies (consent, which you can withdraw at any time).

Who we share it with

Service providers who help us run the shop: payment processing, hosting, email delivery and delivery carriers. They may only use your data to provide their service to us. Some providers may process data outside the UK; where they do, appropriate safeguards are in place.

How long we keep it

Order records are kept for as long as the law requires for tax purposes, normally six years. Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to resolve them. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

Cookies

Essential cookies keep your basket and remember your cookie choices. Analytics and marketing cookies are only set if you accept them. You can change your choice at any time using “Cookie settings” at the bottom of any page.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it, object to or restrict how we use it, and ask for it in a portable format. To use any of these rights, contact us at [[EMAIL]]. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.

title: Terms of service
body:
These terms apply to orders placed on [[DOMAIN]], operated by [[COMPANY]], [[ADDRESS]]. Contact: [[EMAIL]].

Ordering

Your order is an offer to buy. A contract is formed when we email you to confirm that we have accepted it. If we cannot supply an item we will tell you and refund anything you have paid for it.

Prices and payment

Prices are in pounds sterling and include VAT where it applies. Delivery charges are shown at checkout before you pay. Payment is taken when you place your order, by the methods shown at checkout.

Products

We describe and photograph products as accurately as we can. Colours can look different on screen, and sizes are approximate.

Delivery

See our delivery page. Goods are your responsibility from the moment they are delivered to the address you gave us.

Cancellation and returns

See our returns and refunds page, which sets out your right to cancel and your rights if goods are faulty.

Our liability

Nothing in these terms limits your statutory rights as a consumer, or our liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud. We are not liable for losses that were not foreseeable when the contract was made, or for business losses where you buy as a consumer.

Law

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. If you live in Scotland or Northern Ireland you can also bring proceedings in your local courts.
